ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) base with approximately 15-20% high-intensity (white) pixel clusters distributed as discrete focal anomalies.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Base black pigmentation layer populated by high-contrast white circular/annular blobs (rosettes) and linear streaks; higher concentration of high-intensity pixels in the distal thirds of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 85-90 degrees; notch apex is clearly defined and centered.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular serration profile along the entire trailing boundary; low-amplitude pixel fluctuations in the medial region increasing to high-frequency peaks and valleys towards the lateral tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave-to-convex curve transition from the notch to the tips, resulting in an upward-sweeping, tapered lateral terminal point on both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density spatial distribution of roughly circular, high-contrast white clusters (annular morphology) across the ventral surface, particularly dense in the lateral zones.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple unaligned, high-contrast white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) observed; notable diagonal marks on the left lobe and horizontal streaks on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive presence of circular rosette scars consistent with historical barnacle attachment and multiple sets of linear rake marks.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinctive high-contrast white diagonal scar on the mid-left lobe; cluster of three prominent rosette marks near the leading edge of the right lobe.
